automotive-ev-battery.title: May Mobility to convert 10,000 VW ID. Buzz vehicles into robotaxis
automotive-ev-battery.summary: US tech company May Mobility has announced plans to deploy more than 10,000 autonomous units of the VW ID. Buzz globally by the end of 2031, marking a significant commercialization of autonomous electric vehicles. Initial public road tests will begin in early 2027 in the US, with series deliveries to external fleet operators starting in 2028.

automotive-ev-battery.title: Mercedes board threatens to close German plants and stop investments in Germany
automotive-ev-battery.summary: Mercedes-Benz management has announced a temporary halt to investments in Germany and is considering plant closures in response to labor cost disputes with unions. The automaker's board is demanding cost reductions to maintain the competitiveness of German production facilities.

automotive-ev-battery.title: Kia to invest around €1.8 billion in new plant in India
automotive-ev-battery.summary: Kia plans to construct a second manufacturing facility in Anantapur, Andhra Pradesh, with an expected annual production capacity of 200,000 vehicles. The facility will produce both electric vehicles and internal combustion engine models to serve India's growing automotive market.

automotive-ev-battery.title: VW's Scout brand begins production of first test vehicles at new US plant
automotive-ev-battery.summary: Volkswagen's revived Scout brand has commenced assembly of validation vehicles at its new manufacturing facility in Blythewood, South Carolina. Full production operations will commence within several months as construction of the factory is finalized.

automotive-ev-battery.title: VW launches the ID. ERA 5X in China with pricing
automotive-ev-battery.summary: Volkswagen's new ID. ERA 5X SUV debuted in China at approximately 13,530 euros, featuring the innovative Compact Main Platform that maximizes interior space despite smaller external dimensions. The vehicle offers partially automated assistance systems and represents a significant product launch for the Chinese EV market.

automotive-ev-battery.title: Hyundai explores investment in Posco graphite project in Vietnam
automotive-ev-battery.summary: Hyundai Motor Group is evaluating a 100 billion won investment (approximately 67.6 million euros) in Posco Future M's synthetic graphite production facility in Vietnam. The investment would secure preferred purchasing rights for anode materials essential for EV battery production.

automotive-ev-battery.title: UK funds project for recovering nickel, cobalt and copper
automotive-ev-battery.summary: ReOre Technologies has launched the government-backed Cascade project to recover critical battery materials from mining waste, in collaboration with Aberdeen Minerals and Camborne School of Mines. The two-year initiative aims to establish domestic supplies of nickel, cobalt, and copper for the UK battery industry.

automotive-ev-battery.title: Dacia Sandero electric version expected to achieve around 400 km range
automotive-ev-battery.summary: The next-generation Dacia Sandero will include a fully electric variant built on the RGMP Small platform with an estimated 400-kilometer range. The electric model is expected to launch in 2028, expanding Renault's affordable EV lineup.

automotive-ev-battery.title: Daimler Buses Italia to supply TUA Abruzzo with 40 new electric buses
automotive-ev-battery.summary: Daimler Buses Italia and charging infrastructure provider STI have secured a tender to supply 40 electric low-floor city buses to Italian regional transport operator TUA Abruzzo, with options for eight additional vehicles. The contract includes responsibility for establishing charging infrastructure at TUA's Pescara depot.

automotive-ev-battery.title: British Gas orders nearly 2,000 VW Transporters, some of which are electric
automotive-ev-battery.summary: Volkswagen Commercial Vehicles has delivered 1,986 vehicles to British Gas, comprising both electric Transporters and diesel models. The exact breakdown of electric versus conventional vehicles has not been publicly disclosed.

science-space.title: SpaceX launches Starship on ambitious 22-hour Flight 15 test, but aborts booster 'chopsticks' catch
science-space.summary: SpaceX's Starship megarocket successfully reached orbit during its 15th test flight on November 13, marking continued progress in the development of the company's fully reusable super-heavy launch system. The company opted to abort its plan to catch the vehicle's massive Super Heavy booster at the launch site, prioritizing mission success and data collection.

science-space.title: Outbursts from a Massive Star
science-space.summary: Using NASA's Chandra X-ray Observatory, astronomers have identified the trigger mechanism behind repeated outbursts from AT 2016blu, a volatile giant star located approximately 30 million light-years away in the spiral galaxy NGC 4559. This discovery advances understanding of stellar instability and explosive phenomena in distant galaxies.

science-space.title: Astronomers trace mystery radio signals back to cosmic odd couple of white dwarf and sun-like star
science-space.summary: Astronomers have successfully traced previously mysterious radio signals to a binary star system consisting of a white dwarf and a sun-like star located over 5,000 light-years away. The discovery demonstrates the capability of radio wavelength observations to detect stellar activity and magnetic phenomena at unprecedented distances.

science-space.title: Rocket Lab launching 100th space mission early on Nov. 14: Watch it live
science-space.summary: Rocket Lab is preparing to launch its 100th space mission shortly after midnight on November 14, marking a significant milestone for the commercial launch provider. The company's achievement underscores the growing accessibility and frequency of space launch operations in the commercial sector.

science-space.title: 60 years ago the Leonid meteor shower produced 144,000 meteors per hour. Could it happen again?
science-space.summary: The Leonid meteor shower, which produced one of the most spectacular meteor storms in recorded history 60 years ago with over 144,000 meteors per hour, may deliver a similarly dramatic display as the 2026 peak approaches. Skywatchers are encouraged to prepare for the possibility of witnessing an exceptional astronomical event.

science-space.title: On this day in space! Nov. 13, 1971: NASA's Mariner 9 becomes 1st spacecraft to orbit Mars
science-space.summary: On November 13, 1971, NASA's Mariner 9 became the first spacecraft to successfully orbit Mars, providing the first detailed close-up observations of the Martian surface. This historic achievement established the foundation for subsequent Mars exploration missions and transformed scientific understanding of the Red Planet.

science-space.title: California's brand-new Air & Space Center, home of the space shuttle Endeavour, opens today
science-space.summary: The California Science Center's newly constructed Samuel Oschin Air & Space Center officially opened to the public on November 13, featuring the Space Shuttle Endeavour as its centerpiece. The facility represents a major addition to public science education and space exploration outreach on the West Coast.

science-space.title: Gemini Astronaut Photos Inspired Early Earth Observation Program
science-space.summary: During the final Gemini XII mission in November 1966, astronauts James A. Lovell Jr. and Buzz Aldrin Jr. successfully demonstrated critical techniques for lunar missions while simultaneously contributing to the development of Earth observation programs through their photographic documentation. The mission's dual accomplishments established important foundations for both human spaceflight and remote sensing technology.

science-space.title: A Global Rebound for Mangroves
science-space.summary: After decades of ecological decline, mangrove forests worldwide are experiencing a significant recovery, representing an important positive development for coastal ecosystems and biodiversity. This reversal of previous trends highlights the potential for environmental restoration through conservation efforts.

science-space.title: This AI 'mechanic' can peer inside the black box of other neural networks
science-space.summary: Researchers have developed an artificial intelligence system capable of interpreting and analyzing the internal operations of other neural networks, advancing the field of AI explainability and transparency. This breakthrough addresses a critical challenge in understanding how complex machine learning models make decisions.

finance-markets.title: Will Jensen Huang sell his $135bn of stock?
finance-markets.summary: Nvidia co-founder Jensen Huang faces potential pressure to divest his substantial shareholding following his resignation over personal conduct issues, though any sale attempt would carry significant legal and market risks. The uncertainty surrounding potential share liquidation has implications for market stability given Huang's controlling stake in the semiconductor giant.

finance-markets.title: AI believers hold the line after Nvidia ructions
finance-markets.summary: Stock market investors have largely maintained bullish positions on artificial intelligence stocks despite recent corporate governance concerns at Nvidia, signaling confidence in the sector's long-term prospects. The resilience reflects broader investor appetite for AI exposure despite concentrated risk in the mega-cap technology space.

finance-markets.title: Anthropic's Amodei 'not super fussed' about market turmoil ahead of IPO
finance-markets.summary: Anthropic's chief executive has dismissed concerns about technology stock volatility as the AI laboratory prepares for its planned $1.5 trillion initial public offering. The company's confidence reflects strong investor demand for artificial intelligence enterprises despite recent market headwinds.

finance-markets.title: Bessent blames Lutnick's commerce department for failure to blacklist Megaspeed
finance-markets.summary: US Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen has directed criticism at Commerce Secretary Marco Lutnick regarding the administration's handling of sanctions related to the Nvidia scandal. The public disagreement underscores emerging tensions within the Trump administration over technology policy and export controls.

finance-markets.title: Sam Bankman-Fried would have made nearly $40bn in Anthropic IPO
finance-markets.summary: Imprisoned cryptocurrency executive Sam Bankman-Fried stands to forfeit an estimated $40 billion windfall from his early-stage investment in Anthropic following the AI firm's forthcoming initial public offering. The unrealized gain highlights the substantial wealth concentration in high-growth technology ventures.

finance-markets.title: Troubled Sherritt Misses Payment as Liquidity Crisis Deepens
finance-markets.summary: Canadian mining company Sherritt International has defaulted on an interest payment for secured notes, signaling a critical deterioration in its financial position due to US sanctions that forced production halts in Cuba. The liquidity crisis reflects mounting pressure on companies operating under comprehensive international sanctions regimes.

finance-markets.title: Arm boss Rene Haas approached in Nvidia CEO search
finance-markets.summary: Arm Holdings chief executive Rene Haas has been approached as a potential candidate to succeed Jensen Huang at Nvidia following Huang's resignation over personal conduct violations. The move signals the board's effort to stabilize the company's leadership amid ongoing governance concerns.

finance-markets.title: Jeff Currie Says He's Bearish on Copper Due to China
finance-markets.summary: Senior strategist Jeff Currie has adopted a pessimistic stance on copper prices, citing weakness in Chinese economic demand and attributing gold's recent decline to dollar liquidity constraints. The outlook suggests deteriorating commodity market fundamentals tied to slowing global economic growth.

finance-markets.title: US aviation regulator lifts order that grounded thousands of flights
finance-markets.summary: The Federal Aviation Administration has restored normal flight operations after resolving a temporary telecommunications outage that had grounded thousands of aircraft across US airports. The disruption highlighted vulnerabilities in critical aviation infrastructure systems.

finance-markets.title: Trump will not raise Nvidia spy issue with Xi at summit, officials say
finance-markets.summary: The Trump administration has decided to deprioritize the Nvidia espionage controversy in upcoming diplomatic discussions with Chinese and Russian leadership at a trilateral summit. The decision suggests a strategic retreat from escalating technology-related tensions with Beijing.

tech-ai.title: Jensen Huang's departure blasts big hole in AI startup funding, VCs and founders say
tech-ai.summary: Nvidia's departure of cofounder Jensen Huang signals a potential shift in the company's massive AI startup investment strategy, with venture capitalists and founders anticipating smaller funding rounds and lower valuations going forward. Huang's leadership had positioned Nvidia as a major funder pouring tens of billions into the AI startup ecosystem.

tech-ai.title: Export-banned Nvidia chips are behind China's most powerful AI models — uh-oh, Jensen!
tech-ai.summary: Recent research reveals that China's most advanced artificial intelligence models were trained using Nvidia chips that are subject to U.S. export restrictions, raising significant geopolitical and regulatory concerns. The finding highlights the challenges in enforcing technology export controls in an increasingly interconnected global AI development landscape.

tech-ai.title: ChatGPT's new Wallet lets AI agents shop and check out for you
tech-ai.summary: OpenAI has launched ChatGPT Wallet, enabling its Dots AI agents to make purchases on behalf of users through a limited rollout to U.S. Pro subscribers. The wallet integrates with major payment providers and requires user approval before finalizing transactions, expanding the practical capabilities of AI agent automation.

tech-ai.title: AI agent startup LangChain hits $3B valuation
tech-ai.summary: LangChain, a developer platform for AI agents, has reached a $3 billion valuation with its model and platform-agnostic agent management tool LangSmith now serving 7,000 customers. The milestone underscores growing enterprise demand for infrastructure supporting AI agent development and deployment.

tech-ai.title: Amazon has a plan to index the world's online shopping data
tech-ai.summary: Amazon is developing the "World Product Graph," an ambitious initiative to create a comprehensive database of products sold across the entire internet, including items it does not sell itself. The project aims to retain shoppers on Amazon's platform for product research and to enhance the capabilities of AI agents by providing centralized product information.

tech-ai.title: This young startup wants to power floating data centers with the ocean's heat, and investors are already on board
tech-ai.summary: Drogue is developing an innovative approach to sustainable data center operations by harvesting thermal energy from the ocean to power floating data center vessels. The company's first prototype is expected to become operational within two years, representing a novel solution to the energy demands of AI and cloud computing infrastructure.

tech-ai.title: Uber confirms hackers stole thousands of drivers' license information in data breach
tech-ai.summary: Uber has confirmed a security incident in which hackers accessed drivers' license information stored on servers managed by AI cloud company Fireworks AI. The breach highlights ongoing cybersecurity vulnerabilities in the management of sensitive personal data by third-party technology vendors.

tech-ai.title: ElevenLabs' new app combines meeting note-taking and dictation for teams
tech-ai.summary: ElevenLabs has launched ElevenAI, a new application designed to provide meeting note-taking and AI-powered dictation capabilities for teams and enterprise users. The tool leverages the company's voice technology expertise to streamline meeting documentation and transcription workflows.

tech-ai.title: Jensen Huang was reckless with the environment, too
tech-ai.summary: Under Jensen Huang's leadership, Nvidia has become a major driver of the AI industry while simultaneously emerging as one of technology's biggest environmental liabilities. The company's highly sought-after chips have spawned water-intensive manufacturing facilities, strained electrical grids supporting data centers, and created mounting electronic waste concerns.

tech-ai.title: Microsoft's massive Outlook outage might be over
tech-ai.summary: Microsoft Outlook and Office 365 services are recovering after an extended outage lasting nearly two days that affected millions of users globally. The company reported a technical malfunction unrelated to cybersecurity concerns, though some users continued to experience degraded performance and email delivery delays as recovery progressed.

world-news.title: Microsoft 'deeply sorry' for global outage as it reports broad recovery
world-news.summary: A major global outage disrupted Microsoft services including Outlook, Teams, and Copilot across multiple regions, prompting widespread concern about systemic technological vulnerability. The incident underscores the critical infrastructure risks posed by concentrated dependence on a small number of technology providers managing essential global business systems.

world-news.title: Iran war live: Fighting grips Yemen as Qatar, Turkiye sign defence deal
world-news.summary: Escalating military conflict in Yemen has displaced civilians as Qatar and Turkey formalize a joint defence agreement pledging coordinated response to external threats. The bilateral accord reflects shifting geopolitical alignments in the Middle East amid ongoing regional instability.

world-news.title: Rosenberg: Uncompromising Putin ups demands for peace with Ukraine
world-news.summary: Russian President Putin has escalated demands in Ukraine peace negotiations, expanding discussions to include European security arrangements—a position Moscow views as a diplomatic victory. The shift signals hardened Russian negotiating posture and raises questions about the path toward conflict resolution.

world-news.title: German spies handed new powers to tackle 'hybrid threats' from abroad
world-news.summary: Germany has expanded intelligence agency authorities to combat foreign espionage, terrorism, and sabotage operations through enhanced coordination between domestic and foreign services. The reform reflects European concerns about hybrid warfare tactics and foreign interference threats.

world-news.title: FAA grounds all flights across the US over 'telecommunication outage'
world-news.summary: The US Federal Aviation Administration grounded all departing flights nationwide due to a critical communications system failure, later attributed to outdated infrastructure. The incident exposed vulnerabilities in essential aviation infrastructure and prompted rapid remediation.

world-news.title: Nvidia scandal fallout widens as Trump's treasury secretary blames cabinet colleague
world-news.summary: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent accused Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick of failing to enforce export controls on Nvidia semiconductor chips to entities with alleged Chinese connections. The intra-cabinet dispute reveals tensions over technology export policy and national security enforcement.

world-news.title: Afghanistan's new road to China ends at a closed border
world-news.summary: The Taliban government has constructed a road through the Wakhan Corridor intended to establish direct trade routes with China and reduce dependence on Pakistan. The initiative signals Afghanistan's geopolitical realignment and efforts to diversify international economic partnerships.

world-news.title: Measles-associated deaths reach 10 in US after two more deaths reported
world-news.summary: The United States has recorded ten measles-related deaths amid an outbreak totaling over 5,400 confirmed cases in 2026, signaling a significant public health crisis. The escalating death toll raises urgent concerns about vaccination rates and disease transmission across the country.

world-news.title: Why is Microsoft's outage lasting so long and will emails be lost?
world-news.summary: Microsoft continues recovery efforts following a significant global outage affecting Outlook and Teams services, with investigation into the duration and potential data loss implications. The extended disruption raised questions about service resilience and backup system effectiveness.

world-news.title: Setback for SpaceX Starship rocket's double-catch test
world-news.summary: SpaceX aborted an attempted booster catch during a Starship test, resulting in the rocket's descent into the ocean rather than successful recovery. The setback represents a challenge to the company's ambitious reusable launch vehicle development program.

health-biotech.title: Moderna readies commercial cancer vaccine production ahead of FDA filing
health-biotech.summary: Moderna is preparing large-scale manufacturing capacity for its Merck-partnered cancer vaccine and plans to submit a marketing application to the FDA by year-end. The company's readiness to scale production marks a significant milestone in bringing a personalized cancer immunotherapy to market.

health-biotech.title: Argenx is spending billions to push beyond Vyvgart
health-biotech.summary: Argenx has completed two acquisitions worth a combined potential of approximately $3.4 billion under new CEO Karen Massey as the rare disease company seeks to expand its immunology portfolio beyond its flagship treatment Vyvgart. The strategic investments signal the company's ambition to diversify its drug pipeline and reduce reliance on a single product.

health-biotech.title: HHS plans funding for research into ibogaine for PTSD
health-biotech.summary: The Trump administration will allocate up to $4.9 million to support clinical research into ibogaine, a psychedelic compound showing promise as a potential treatment for post-traumatic stress disorder and addiction. The funding reflects growing federal interest in exploring novel psychedelic-based therapies for difficult-to-treat mental health conditions.

health-biotech.title: Regeneron posts mid-stage POTS data; Kyverna completes CAR-T filing
health-biotech.summary: Regeneron has demonstrated positive mid-stage data for its monoclonal antibody baloncibart in treating postural orthostatic tachycardia syndrome, achieving an average 11.4-beat-per-minute heart rate reduction. The data represents progress in addressing a debilitating autonomic disorder with limited treatment options.

health-biotech.title: New addiction society guidance on medetomidine's brutal withdrawal
health-biotech.summary: The American Society of Addiction Medicine has released the first national clinical guidance for identifying and managing withdrawal symptoms in patients who have used medetomidine. The guidance addresses an emerging public health concern as the sedative drug gains attention among vulnerable populations.

health-biotech.title: Windward Bio hits Nasdaq with $175M IPO, plus another $50M from Sanofi
health-biotech.summary: Windward Bio, a respiratory disease-focused biotech, completed its initial public offering raising $175 million and secured an additional $50 million investment from Sanofi. The dual funding round positions the company to advance its pipeline of respiratory therapeutics.

health-biotech.title: Novo submits sickle cell drug; Flagship, Gates Foundation deepen ties
health-biotech.summary: Novo has submitted a regulatory application for a sickle cell disease treatment acquired through a billion-dollar licensing agreement, positioning the medicine as a potential future blockbuster. The submission marks progress in addressing a serious genetic blood disorder with limited therapeutic options.

health-biotech.title: Democrats coalesce around 'Medicare for More,' 'Medikids' proposals
health-biotech.summary: Democratic lawmakers are unifying behind proposals to expand Medicare eligibility to broader segments of the American population, including a potential 'Medikids' program. The legislative initiatives signal a strategic pivot in healthcare policy discussions ahead of upcoming congressional sessions.

health-biotech.title: Senators introduce bill to curb conflicts of interest on preventive care panel
health-biotech.summary: Senators have introduced legislation to address financial conflicts of interest among members of the U.S. Preventive Services Task Force, who may benefit financially from their policy recommendations. The bill responds to concerns that panel members' financial interests could influence decisions affecting preventive care guidelines.

health-biotech.title: Doctors have questions about the Watchman. Boston Scientific has a sales pitch.
health-biotech.summary: An investigation reveals that Boston Scientific's marketing efforts for its Watchman cardiac implant may have outpaced the clinical evidence supporting its use in certain patient populations. The reporting raises questions about the alignment between promotional claims and published scientific data.

startups-vc.title: Anthropic Seeks Record $88.5B Tied To Public Market Debut
startups-vc.summary: Anthropic has filed to raise up to $88.5 billion through its planned IPO and concurrent private placement, potentially making it the largest fundraise tied to a public market debut. The AI giant's updated S-1 filing reveals new details about the proposed share price range and offering size.

startups-vc.title: Jensen Huang's departure blasts big hole in AI startup funding, VCs and founders say
startups-vc.summary: Nvidia's leadership transition has sparked concern among venture capitalists and founders who have relied on the company's substantial investment activity in AI startups. The departure signals potential for smaller funding checks and lower valuations across the startup ecosystem.

startups-vc.title: Crunchbase Data: Nvidia's Startup Funding Deals Hit A Record. What's Next After Huang?
startups-vc.summary: Nvidia and its venture arm NVentures have maintained a record pace as one of the most active startup investors, backing many of the largest venture deals in 2026. The analysis examines Nvidia's investment portfolio and what the future may hold following recent leadership changes.

startups-vc.title: The Week's 10 Biggest Funding Rounds: Agentic AI And Infrastructure Are Still On A Roll
startups-vc.summary: Agentic AI and infrastructure startups dominated funding activity this week, with Mirendil raising $1 billion in Series A for AI-driven R&D and Mercor securing $750 million to connect AI developers with human experts. The strong investment momentum demonstrates sustained venture capital appetite for AI-related infrastructure and applications.

startups-vc.title: AI agent startup LangChain hits $3B valuation
startups-vc.summary: LangChain has achieved a $3 billion valuation while serving 7,000 customers with its model and platform agnostic agent management tool LangSmith. The milestone reflects strong market adoption of AI agent development infrastructure.

startups-vc.title: The Crunchbase Unicorn Board Tops 1,900 Companies In October, With 34 Companies Joining — Half Under 4 Years Old
startups-vc.summary: The Crunchbase Unicorn Board reached a historic milestone of 1,900 private companies in October, with 34 new entrants adding over $96 billion in value and $14.8 billion in funding. The U.S. surpassed 1,000 private unicorn companies for the first time, underscoring robust startup growth.

startups-vc.title: OpenAI acquires Odessia, travel startup created by Sonder founder
startups-vc.summary: OpenAI has acquired Odessia, a travel startup founded by Sonder founder Francis Davidson, marking the company's entry into the travel sector. While OpenAI has not disclosed specific plans for the acquisition, Davidson's established reputation in the travel industry suggests strategic intent.

startups-vc.title: PSI is trying to make a business out of AI-driven scientific discovery
startups-vc.summary: PSI is commercializing AI-driven scientific discovery by leveraging an unreleased Anthropic model to solve complex research problems, including a fundamental quantum computing question that scientists have pursued for nearly two decades. The startup demonstrates the emerging business potential of AI-powered research applications.

startups-vc.title: After challenging Google's Android with Cyanogen, its co-founder takes aim at Windows for AI era
startups-vc.summary: Kora, launched by the co-founder of Cyanogen, positions itself as a free-to-use Windows alternative targeting users who rely heavily on AI models and agents. The startup represents an emerging effort to build operating system alternatives optimized for AI-centric workflows.

startups-vc.title: Jensen Resigns, Sequoia Pulls Back to the Bay, and Anthropic's IPO Draws 6x Demand: The Top Takeaways from 20VC x SaaStr
startups-vc.summary: A significant week in venture capital saw Jensen Huang's resignation, Sequoia's strategic retreat from geographic expansion, and overwhelming demand for Anthropic's IPO. The developments signal shifts in venture capital deployment strategies and major leadership changes affecting the AI startup ecosystem.

cybersecurity.title: Microsoft Fixes Nearly 1,100 Security Vulnerabilities
cybersecurity.summary: Microsoft released updates addressing almost 1,100 security vulnerabilities across Windows and supported software, including 63 critical flaws and a zero-day vulnerability in Microsoft Outlook. The Patch Tuesday release coincides with significant security updates from Adobe, Apple, Google, and Mozilla.

cybersecurity.title: FBI Says North Korean Hackers Stole Over $400 Million in Crypto Using Deepfake Video Calls
cybersecurity.summary: The FBI has confirmed that North Korean threat actors have stolen more than $400 million in cryptocurrency through a social engineering scheme dubbed FaceStealer over the past 18 months. The coordinated attack employed deepfake video technology to manipulate victims into unauthorized crypto transfers.

cybersecurity.title: SilentAir Hijacks Asian Telecom Networks to Intercept SMS 2FA Codes and Spy on Taiwanese Users
cybersecurity.summary: Security researchers identified a state-level spying operation called SilentAir that exploited compromised equipment within Asian mobile operators to intercept calls and texts of targeted individuals, primarily in Taiwan. The attackers gained access to infrastructure across at least six Asian countries to compromise two-factor authentication mechanisms.

cybersecurity.title: Operation Endgame Takes Down Gootloader, CastleRAT and StealC Servers, Seizes 6.4M Stolen Logins
cybersecurity.summary: An international law enforcement operation dismantled servers associated with three major malware tools—Gootloader, CastleRAT, and StealC—used by criminals for computer compromise and ransomware deployment. The operation resulted in the seizure of approximately 6.4 million stolen login credentials belonging to over 40,000 victims.

cybersecurity.title: Trezor Confirms Hidden Implants in CryptoBilis-Sold Wallets That Can Steal Recovery Phrases
cybersecurity.summary: Hardware wallet manufacturer Trezor discovered that three Trezor Safe 5 devices sold through reseller CryptoBilis contained malicious hardware implants capable of extracting recovery phrases. The implants read sensitive cryptographic data from the device display and transmit it over mobile networks to attacker-controlled servers.

cybersecurity.title: Hackers Exploit PHP2Shell Flaws in Check Point Gateways to Deploy TSGA Backdoor and Wipe ESXi Files
cybersecurity.summary: Threat actors have been actively exploiting PHP2Shell vulnerabilities in unpatched Check Point Security Gateways to gain initial access and deploy a previously unreported backdoor called TSGA. The campaign, which began in October 2026, specifically targeted Israeli organizations using a multi-stage attack that leverages privilege escalation in Gaia OS.

cybersecurity.title: PostgreSQL Patches 52 Flaws, Including 22-Year-Old Bug Enabling Authenticated RCE
cybersecurity.summary: PostgreSQL released updates addressing 52 security vulnerabilities, including a critical type confusion flaw tracked as CVE-2026-6460 with a CVSS score of 8.8 that has existed for 22 years. The flaw allows authenticated database users to execute arbitrary code on the server with elevated privileges.

cybersecurity.title: U.K. Sanctions Cryptomus for RU Money Laundering
cybersecurity.summary: The United Kingdom imposed economic sanctions against Cryptomus, a cryptocurrency platform identified as a major conduit for ransomware payments, narcotics trafficking, darknet market transactions, and other cybercriminal activities. The platform reportedly facilitates money laundering that helps Russia evade existing international financial restrictions.

cybersecurity.title: New Mior and Skyfall Attacks Let Rogue Cloud Hosts Steal Secrets From AMD SEV-SNP VMs
cybersecurity.summary: Two newly disclosed attacks—Mior and Skyfall—enable malicious cloud service providers to extract sensitive data from AMD SEV-SNP-protected virtual machines designed to isolate workloads from host operator interference. Mior additionally permits memory modification and falsification of software attestation reports, requiring both hypervisor and BIOS-level access.

cybersecurity.title: Hackers Exploit N-central Flaws to Infect 21 Servers, Including 19 Running Hotfix 2
cybersecurity.summary: N-able announced it is implementing additional security precautions following the public disclosure of multiple flaws designated as 4EverAble2Shell and Agent2Shell that have been exploited to compromise 21 servers. The company has restricted certain N-central features and integrations during remediation efforts to limit further exploitation risk.

crypto-web3.title: Bitcoin firm Nakamoto owes Kraken $165 million, more than its entire market value
crypto-web3.summary: Nakamoto, a Nasdaq-listed bitcoin treasury firm, faces significant financial distress with a $165 million debt to Kraken that exceeds its entire market capitalization. Approximately 70% of the firm's bitcoin holdings are pledged as collateral against the loan, purchased at roughly $118,000 per coin, creating severe liquidation risk as bitcoin trades below $69,000.

crypto-web3.title: Bitcoin hits 12-week low as dollar rallies on interest-rate outlook, liquidations top $1.6 billion
crypto-web3.summary: Bitcoin fell below $70,000 for the first time since August, declining 3.5% since midnight UTC amid dollar strength and hawkish Federal Reserve expectations. The decline coincided with over $1.6 billion in cryptocurrency liquidations across the market.

crypto-web3.title: Ethereum treasury firm BTCS sold ether at a loss to keep $64 million Aave loan healthy
crypto-web3.summary: BTCS, a Nasdaq-listed ethereum treasury firm, was forced to liquidate ether holdings at a loss to maintain its $64 million Aave loan as collateral values declined. The firm's 46,676 ETH backing the loan faces liquidation risk if ether drops to approximately $1,700.

crypto-web3.title: Bitcoin miners pay Paraguay $350 million a year, but AI is pushing them out
crypto-web3.summary: Paraguay's bitcoin mining operations, which generate $350 million annually in mining contracts, face termination on December 31, 2027, as the state utility prioritizes a 15-year power agreement with a Founders Fund-backed AI campus. The shift reflects growing competition between cryptocurrency mining and artificial intelligence infrastructure for renewable energy resources.

crypto-web3.title: Kraken parent Payward posts 66% drop in Q3 adjusted EBITDA, plans US prediction markets and personal finance AI agent
crypto-web3.summary: Payward, the parent company of exchange Kraken, reported a 66% year-over-year decline in third-quarter adjusted EBITDA to $60 million, though funded accounts grew 37%. The company plans to launch US prediction markets and develop a personal finance AI agent as part of its diversification strategy.

crypto-web3.title: Bitcoin plunges to $68,000 as Anthropic IPO frenzy adds to market jitters
crypto-web3.summary: Bitcoin declined sharply as investor capital flowed into Anthropic's highly anticipated initial public offering alongside broader risk-off market sentiment. Analysts attributed the decline primarily to capital reallocation rather than direct technical factors related to Nvidia's recent leadership changes.

crypto-web3.title: Hyperliquid leapfrogs Bybit, Kraken and OKX in open interest as Q3 positions grow 80%
crypto-web3.summary: Hyperliquid captured 11.7% of open interest across itself and eight major centralized exchange rivals during the third quarter, reflecting 80% growth in positions and rising market share concentration. The platform has surpassed established exchanges including Bybit, Kraken, and OKX in this key metric.

crypto-web3.title: UK, Singapore, and Thailand central banks complete foreign exchange settlement trial linking traditional and tokenized systems
crypto-web3.summary: Three major central banks successfully completed a cross-border foreign exchange settlement trial using Partior's synchronization prototype to link traditional and tokenized financial systems. The initiative demonstrates progress toward interoperability between legacy banking infrastructure and blockchain-based settlement mechanisms.

crypto-web3.title: U.S. Senate Banking Committee races toward hearing on new SEC nominations
crypto-web3.summary: The Senate Banking Committee expedited review of President Donald Trump's SEC nominees, scheduling hearings for the following week. The rapid advancement signals the committee's priority in filling key regulatory positions overseeing the cryptocurrency and financial services industries.

crypto-web3.title: Tether-backed Twenty One Capital reports $1.09 billion Q3 net income on bitcoin gains
crypto-web3.summary: Twenty One Capital, a Tether-backed investment firm, reported $1.09 billion in third-quarter net income driven primarily by bitcoin appreciation, despite posting a $4.8 million operating loss. The results highlight the volatility and asset-dependent performance of crypto-focused investment vehicles.

energy-climate.title: Q&A: What is in the global 'roadmap' for transitioning away from fossil fuels?
energy-climate.summary: Brazil has released a first-of-its-kind global roadmap outlining a transition away from fossil fuels, described as urgent, inevitable, and achievable. This framework provides concrete pathways for countries to shift their energy systems and represents a significant development in international climate policy negotiations at COP31.

energy-climate.title: China and Türkiye sign $15bn MoU for wind and solar projects at COP31
energy-climate.summary: China and Turkey have agreed to a memorandum of understanding for Beijing to invest up to $15 billion in constructing solar and wind power plants in Turkey. This major bilateral agreement at COP31 signals significant international commitment to renewable energy infrastructure development.

energy-climate.title: Q&A: What is the Brazil-led 'deforestation roadmap'?
energy-climate.summary: Brazil released a comprehensive roadmap aimed at ending deforestation, unveiled during its COP30 presidency and continuing to influence climate negotiations at COP31. The initiative addresses a critical component of climate action by targeting one of the world's largest sources of carbon emissions.

energy-climate.title: Oman signs green hydrogen deals at COP31 in Türkiye
energy-climate.summary: Oman has awarded two integrated green hydrogen projects in Duqm with a combined planned production capacity of approximately 121,000 tonnes annually by 2032. These projects represent significant progress in scaling hydrogen production as a key decarbonization technology in the Middle East.

energy-climate.title: How the low-carbon hydrogen mix will scale to 2030
energy-climate.summary: Blue hydrogen currently leads capacity development, but green hydrogen is projected to dominate the market by 2030 as production scales and costs decline. This analysis tracks the evolving hydrogen landscape as a critical component of the global energy transition.

energy-climate.title: The Hydrogen Stream: Uniper and VNG Produce first green hydrogen at 30 MW facility in Germany
energy-climate.summary: Uniper and VNG have begun producing green hydrogen at a 30 MW facility in Germany, with plans to transport the hydrogen through a converted natural gas pipeline to a TotalEnergies refinery beginning in 2027. This project demonstrates the emerging infrastructure for hydrogen transport and industrial applications in Europe.

energy-climate.title: Sodium-ion batteries close gap with lithium-ion as utility-scale storage opportunities grow
energy-climate.summary: Sodium-ion batteries are achieving performance parity with lithium-ion in key metrics, with commercial cells reaching energy densities of 175 Wh/kg and strong low-temperature capabilities, positioning them as a promising alternative for utility-scale energy storage. This technological advancement could diversify battery supply chains and reduce costs for grid-scale renewable energy deployment.

energy-climate.title: Envision and ju:niz Energy plan 442MWh storage project in Bavaria
energy-climate.summary: Envision Energy and ju:niz Energy are developing a 442 MWh battery energy storage system project in Bavaria, Germany, known as Smareg 13. This project enhances Europe's energy storage capacity to support the continent's renewable energy transition.

energy-climate.title: China's highways could generate 182 TWh of solar annually
energy-climate.summary: Researchers from Tongji University have developed a framework estimating that China's highways could generate approximately 182 TWh of solar power annually, equivalent to 1.85% of national electricity consumption. This innovative approach to distributed solar deployment could unlock significant renewable energy potential across existing infrastructure.

energy-climate.title: Dark clouds gather over Germany's solar sector
energy-climate.summary: Germany's solar market faces significant headwinds as module prices stagnate and battery storage costs are expected to rise, with industry experts warning of challenges if renewable energy policy reforms are not implemented promptly. The sector's viability depends on timely amendments to Germany's Renewable Energy Sources Act.

asia-pacific.title: White House confirms US-China-Russia trilateral on Apec sidelines
asia-pacific.summary: The White House has confirmed an unprecedented trilateral meeting between leaders of the United States, China, and Russia will take place during the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation summit in Shenzhen next week. The high-level diplomatic engagement signals potential discussions on major geopolitical and economic issues affecting the region.

asia-pacific.title: China holds 80% of world's underwater data centre patents as computing energy demands grow
asia-pacific.summary: China dominates the global underwater data centre technology sector, holding 80 percent of world patents in the field according to a two-decade study. This strategic advantage in green computing infrastructure reflects China's transformation from a technology follower to a leading force in critical subsea digital technologies.

asia-pacific.title: Indonesia's commodity export U-turn: no monopoly, just all the data
asia-pacific.summary: Indonesia has reversed its plan to establish a state-owned enterprise monopoly over palm oil, coal, and ferroalloy exports, addressing business concerns while maintaining government oversight mechanisms. The decision reflects ongoing debate over balancing state control with market transparency in managing the nation's commodity trade.

asia-pacific.title: Pax Silica means peace. In the Philippines, it's a fight
asia-pacific.summary: The Philippines is developing a 1,620-hectare technology hub known as 'Pax Silica' as part of a US-led initiative, though the project has sparked significant public protest and clashes with anti-riot police. The scheme reflects broader geopolitical competition in Southeast Asia and domestic political tensions over foreign-backed infrastructure projects.

asia-pacific.title: Malaysia's Melaka election begins as Anwar's PH seeks to counter resurgent Umno
asia-pacific.summary: Voters in Malaysia's Melaka state began casting ballots in a significant electoral contest where Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim's ruling coalition faces a challenging third battle against the resurgent opposition Umno party in four months. The election outcome will indicate political momentum ahead of future national contests.

asia-pacific.title: South Korea's Options in a Fragmented World
asia-pacific.summary: South Korea faces strategic choices regarding its participation in competing international groupings, as the nation seeks to balance its geopolitical positioning without compromising broader regional and global relationships. The analysis examines how Seoul's alignment decisions could reshape its role in regional security and economic frameworks.

asia-pacific.title: Will AI Change North Korea's Nuclear Calculus?
asia-pacific.summary: Artificial intelligence development could fundamentally alter nuclear deterrence dynamics on the Korean Peninsula, potentially destabilizing the asymmetric vulnerabilities that currently underpin regional security. The analysis examines how advanced AI technologies may reshape Pyongyang's strategic calculations and broader regional stability.

asia-pacific.title: Why China's Push to Boost Spending Is Falling Short
asia-pacific.summary: Despite implementing new central and provincial-level fiscal measures, China's economic stimulus efforts have failed to produce substantial improvements in key economic indicators. The shortfall highlights challenges in translating policy announcements into tangible economic growth acceleration.

asia-pacific.title: Japan and the US Need an Allied Technology Market, Not New Tariffs
asia-pacific.summary: Japan and the United States should prioritize building a collaborative market framework for advanced robotics and industrial automation rather than pursuing protectionist tariff measures. The analysis emphasizes mutual economic and strategic incentives for deepening technological integration between the two allied nations.

asia-pacific.title: Japan Needs Muslim Workers. Is It Ready for Muslim Communities?
asia-pacific.summary: Japan's growing reliance on Muslim immigrant workers necessitates institutional and social adaptations to accommodate religious practices and cultural needs. The analysis examines tensions between maintaining traditional social structures and creating inclusive frameworks for religious minorities in Japanese society.
